notes.title: Bad Summer's Kickstarter is Live!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Bad Summer Kickstarter is LIVE + Major Demo Update Released![/b][/h1][p]Today’s a huge day for us.[/p][p]Our [b]Kickstarter campaign[/b] is officially live, and with it comes our [b]biggest demo update yet[/b] for [i]Bad Summer[/i].[/p][p][/p][p]🆕 [b]What’s new in the update:[/b]
• New horror scenes and dialogue
• Expanded and polished romance routes
• More voiced lines
• Improved visuals and UI
• Hidden easter eggs (if you can find them)
• Bug fixes and general polish[/p][p]This update brings the demo closer than ever to the full experience we want to deliver: a horror romance visual novel with emotional weight, tough choices, and stories that stay with you.[/p][p]But we need your help to finish it.[/p][p]We’re two indie devs - a sister team - who’ve poured years into this project, handling everything from writing and coding to music and voice direction. With your support on Kickstarter, we can complete the full game the way it deserves to be made.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45283991/44f7bf84ed4f19ea6b20cc48f017e2c710c3c22f.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45283991/ab634bfa1d87e2ba8f6c48dfdcb723e424304a2c.png"][/img][/p][p]This is another major update to add much needed polish to the game, and it's absolutely free.[/p][p]But we can’t go any further without you.[/p][p][/p][h1]👉[url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/badsummer/bad-summer-a-horror-romance-visual-novel"]BAD SUMMER PRELAUNCH PAGE[/url][/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45283991/3e2bad80a670c7bd01b0a1c30453824b8d7a2124.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1][b]WHY KICKSTARTER?[/b][/h1][p]Because we’ve taken [i]Bad Summer[/i] as far as we can on our own. We’re a sister duo building this game from our tiny apartment, doing nearly everything ourselves: writing, music, coding, marketing, and more. And we’ve had help from friends and collaborators who believed in us, and in this game.[/p][p]This Kickstarter isn’t just about funding a game.
It’s about finishing a story that people have already fallen in love with and making sure every member of our team gets the recognition and compensation they deserve.[/p][p]If you’ve played the demo, if you’ve seen the art, if a single line or moment stuck with you, [b]please consider backing [i]Bad Summer[/i]. Or even just following the campaign. Every bit of support matters right now.[/b][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]Check out our website for more info: [url="https://sjdreamfree.com/kickstarter/"]https://sjdreamfree.com/kickstarter/[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: V2.0.1 Hotfix
notes.content: [p]Hey, Campers! Enjoying the Extended Demo update? We certainly hope so![/p][p][/p][p]This update introduced some bugs. We got to work on fixing those right away![/p][p][/p][h3]Phone calls[/h3][list][*][p]We cleaned up the logic in the phone call section. One mistake during the phone calls were resulting in game overs. That wasn't right. Now, players have more room to make mistakes. Not everyone can be perfect, right?[/p][/*][*][p]Added some extra sound effects.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Backrooms/anomaly mini-game[/h3][list][*][p]Some odd things were happening during the game over screens during this section. Specifically with the flashlight. That's fixed![/p][/*][*][p]Cleaned up the code a bit.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Typos[/h3][list][*][p]We caught some more typos! [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Playing Oliver's spooky sections should be a smoother experience. Be on the lookout for more updates, folks! We're already cooking up a new sprite. Camp Bear Ridge is about to get more interesting...[/p]

notes.title: Bad Summer Updated Demo Drops June 9th!
notes.content:
[h2]A new update is in the works![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45283991/c69554ecbd9e933a9fa3687e19cd53afc726487c.png[/img]

The campfire’s been relit, and the screams?
Yeah, they’re louder this time.

We’ve been hard at work behind the scenes, and we’re finally ready to share the updated Bad Summer demo with you on June 9th. This isn’t just a polish. It’s an expansion. Expect:

📖 [b]New story content[/b] - Dive deeper into the mystery. Uncover fresh clues, new character moments, and choices that matter.
💀 [b]More scares [/b]- Think you were safe the first time? We’ve added new horrors, fresh ways to die, and eerie surprises you won’t see coming.
💔 [b]Richer character dynamics[/b] - Get to know your favorites (and enemies) even better. Some bonds strengthen. Some break.
🎮 [b]Improved UI + visuals[/b] - Sharper design, smoother experience, more polish across the board.
And much more...

Whether you're returning to Camp Bear Ridge or stepping in for the first time, this is the definitive demo experience.
We dare you to play it.

[h1]Bad Summer will be participating in Steam's Next Fest. Don't miss out on the fun! Mark your calendars, folks. June 9th is coming soon![/h1] 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3512290/Bad_Summer_Demo/

notes.title: Bad Summer's Demo is out NOW!
notes.content:
[h1]Bad Summer's demo is available to play now![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45283991/efe38ab900570e1d6255d8a11aaa4ae9cc4c7ff8.jpg[/img]

Secrets lurk in every shadow, trust is a gamble, and the wrong decision could cost you everything.  Experience the first chapter of Bad Summer, a horror romance visual novel where choices matter. With a cast of over [b]a dozen talented voice actors[/b], [b]jumpscares, 20k words,[/b] and [b]four unique love interests[/b] to choose from, Bad Summer is an experience you won't soon forget! 

[h3]✨ What's in the demo?[/h3]
The demo is five hours of gameplay (all paths), introducing you to Jenny, Oliver, and some of the camp's key characters. It's a great way to get a feel for the atmosphere, setting, and tone of the game, as well as a sneak peek into the thrilling story that’s about to unfold.

[h3]🎥 Watch the Trailer:[/h3]
Check out the cinematic trailer below to get a taste of the world of Bad Summer and the characters you’ll be meeting! 
[previewyoutube=hRjkeEYdXVo;full][/previewyoutube]

Enjoy the demo, campers! This is only the beginning of Bad Summer! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3512290/Bad_Summer_Demo/
